subject: Startups
title: The Freemium Trap
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Freemium Trap.

hook.text: Evernote offered a generous free tier. Millions signed up. Almost nobody paid. The company nearly collapsed.

buildup.text: Freemium works only if free users eventually convert. If the free tier is too good, there's no reason to upgrade.

discovery.text: Successful freemium limits the right features. Slack limits message history. Zoom limits meeting length.

twist.text: Some companies find that most free users never convert. They become a cost center, not a growth engine.

climax.text: The best freemium models make free users valuable even if they never pay—through virality, data, or content.

punchline.text: Free users who don't spread or convert are just expenses.

quiz.question: What is a key risk of freemium models?
options: Free users never converting to paid
